causalModel.founding: A void opened where the root layer lifted the ground deep in the jungle. An occupant moved into the void.
causalModel.siteAdvantages: The void is dry and root-walled, with one defensible mouth.
causalModel.occupantsMotive: The occupant has made a lair of the void. The occupant drags in what it has taken.
causalModel.pressures: Evicted families at the hiring camp, 895 m east, no longer forage this way. Any of the families will tell a stranger why, at length.
causalModel.wouldChangeIf: If the lair were cleared, the foraging range of the hiring camp would double.

districts.notes: A Hist root mouth against a mossy rock bank, with a scatter of bones and tools in front of it.

why.what: The district is the mouth of the hollow, its rock bank and the scatter in front of it.
why.whyHere: The root layer lifted the ground here and left a dry void under it.
why.whySpot: The spot is a level pocket on the jungle floor. The roots come down to the ground against rock there.
why.whyNeighbours: No settlement lies within a valley of the place. The hiring camp is nearly a kilometre east, 895 m away.
why.playerPurpose: The district is the way into the lair. It holds the evidence of what the occupant has taken.
why.microGeography: The ground is dark leaf litter on firm ground. A closed canopy covers it.

parcels.orientationWhy: The mouth faces east, toward the hiring camp. The hiring camp is the home of the lost foragers.

why.what: The parcel is the mouth, a rock arch collared with Hist root. The way down lies inside the arch.
why.whyHere: The roots hold up the roof of the void. The arch is the single opening of the void.
why.whySpot: The parcel stands against the rock bank. It stands on the level pocket in front of the bank.
why.whyNeighbours: The bank closes the mouth on the west. The scatter spreads east of the mouth.
why.playerPurpose: The mouth is the way down into the lair. It is also the sole way out of the lair.
why.microGeography: The mouth is rock and living root over a dark opening. Trodden earth lies at the threshold.

playerPurpose.note: Everything the occupant has taken, piled deep in the hollow.
One thing in the den worth the fight.
Takes The Tools ends here. The missing foragers' tools lie at the cave mouth. A creature in the hollow took the foragers. It waits below.

preferCell.why: The record describes the lair as a dry root cave with bones on its floor and a beast's den. The cell is the AutoLoadDoor01 of King of the Murkmire. The AutoLoadDoor01 in this rock loads that cell.

interiorClaim.why: 1 of 31 cells plugins link to vanilla:landscape/rocks/rockcaveentrance02 pass; MugsumpHollowInt01 is a storage, 1 exterior load door; chosen for this door: The record's lair: a dry root cave with bones on its floor and a beast's den, the cell King of the Murkmire's AutoLoadDoor01 in this rock loads.

routes.why: The hiring camp's searchers walk out to the mouth with candles and come back the same way; their feet wore this ground bare toward the camp's track.

approaches.sequence: A visitor comes west through the trees from the hiring camp. The rock bank shows first. The root mass against the bank shows next. The dark mouth between them shows last.
approaches.wayfinding: A trodden path runs west from the hiring camp's side to the mouth. The bank is the sole patch of grey rock among the trees.

networkTerminals.why: The hiring camp's searchers walk out to the mouth with their candles and walk back. Their feet wore a path east toward the camp's track.

combatSpaces.why: The level pocket in front of the mouth is the sole open footing under the trees.

scaleGrounding.why: The place is one mouth, its rock bank and the scatter in front of it. The lair itself is the cell below.

candidates.why: The pocket lies 10 m south-east of the plotted anchor. The pocket is firm and dry. The ground rises on the west side of the pocket for the bank.
The plotted anchor lies 12 m north-west of the chosen pocket.
candidates.rejectedBecause: The east side of the anchor drops into a hummock. The mouth would face into rising ground.
